_comment: Reuses github.token by default. token and token_env override it for this widget. Each source is one GitHub search; results are pooled and de-duplicated, because GitHub search has no OR. @mine expands to every org you belong to plus your own account.
_token_comment: Optional GitHub token override for this widget; empty reuses github.token.
_token_env_comment: Environment variable checked before the shared GitHub token source.
_sources_comment: Named GitHub search queries pooled and de-duplicated into the follow-up queue.
_limit_comment: Maximum pull requests retained after searches are combined.
